# Where the "bug no longer reproduces" proof lives (direct pointers)

The end-to-end regression proof is in the repository at `1791436c02`. Exact locations, so it does
not have to be searched for:

## `tests/unit/test_push_pending_marker.py` (10 tests)

Fixture `rejecting_origin` builds a REAL local bare git origin whose REAL `pre-receive` hook
declines with GH013-shaped stderr, seeds `origin/tickets` so the shape is a diverging branch, and
leaves one unpushed local commit. No mocks anywhere.

- `test_a_declined_push_is_recorded_as_durable_state` — the original defect: a declined push now
  leaves durable state naming the git reason and the backlog. **This is the reproduction.**
- `test_the_async_path_records_the_failure_its_stderr_discards` — limb 1, driving the REAL detached
  `Popen` (`REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=async`), polling the marker on a bounded 60s deadline.
- `test_the_library_surface_reports_it_with_no_logging_handler` — limb 2, via `rebar.push_status()`.
- `test_the_marker_clears_once_a_push_lands` — the hook stops declining and the marker clears, so
  the signal cannot latch on.
- `test_the_best_effort_contract_survives`, `test_marker_write_failure_does_not_fail_the_push` —
  the contract guards: still returns `None`, never raises, HEAD unmoved, commit intact.
- plus non-failure reasons, corrupt-marker, worktree-invisibility and linked-worktree `gitdir:`.

## `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_push_status.py` (5 tests)

- `test_comment_tool_reports_a_rejected_push` — limb 3, driving the real in-process MCP server
  (`build_server().call_tool("comment_ticket", ...)`) against the declining origin. **Before this
  change that exact drive returned `{"result": "ok"}` with two commits stranded** (transcript in
  the earlier "MCP limb CONFIRMED end-to-end" comment); it now returns `push_status.state ==
  "pending"` naming the reason.
- `test_every_write_tool_advertising_a_schema_declares_push_status` — coverage sourced MECHANICALLY
  from `list_tools()`, so a future write tool cannot ship without the field.

## Implementation

`src/rebar/_store/push_state.py` (new) — the durable marker; `src/rebar/_store/push.py` — records
at the single `_raise_if_strict` choke point every terminal failure already routes through, clears
on a push that lands; `src/rebar/__init__.py` — `rebar.push_status()`; `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py` +
`_mcp_writes.py` — the `push_status` field.

## Mutation check — the tests are not tautologies

Re-seeding the exact defect returns them to RED, verified before the change was pushed: deleting
the single `push_state.record_failure(...)` line turns exactly the 5 behaviour tests RED while all
5 contract-guard tests stay GREEN (as they must, since they guard the opposite failure); deleting
the two `push_state.clear(...)` calls turns only `test_the_marker_clears_once_a_push_lands` RED.
Each half of the fix is independently pinned.

## Re-run on the landed tree

59 passed across the five affected test files at `1791436c02`; `make lint`, `make typecheck` (506
files), the MCP schema-drift gate and the module-size gate all green.
